intro: Ikhtiyari. Kamaai ke chaar raste, aur ek warning: aap ke asal adaad o shumar sirf aap ke IB Portal mein hote hain — kisi chat mein nahi.
items: Rebate per lot
Aap ki team ke har lot par trading cost ka ek hissa wapas aata hai. Yeh sargarmi par milta hai, waadon par nahi — trading nahi to rebate nahi.
Profit share
Jab koi strategy nafa ke saath trade band karti hai to profit taqseem hota hai. Sab se bara hissa us ka rehta hai jis ka paisa account mein hai.
Team bonus

Jin logon ko aap laaye hain, jaise jaise woh trading shuru karte hain, structure ke mazeed levels khul sakte hain. Aap ke IB Portal mein dikhta hai keh kaun se levels khul chuke hain aur kaun se abhi lock hain — asal adaad wohi hain jo us screen par hain.
Pools and campaigns
Leader pools aur kuch arsay ke liye chalne wali campaigns aati jati rehti hain. Is liye in par bharosa karne se pehle IB Portal mein mojooda sharait zaroor parh lein.
warning: Trading mein asal khatra hota hai, aur zyada tar retail accounts nuqsan mein rehte hain. Yahan aap ki kamaai is par hai keh asal mein kitni trading hoti hai — kisi aamdani ki zamanat nahi, aur yeh sifar bhi ho sakti hai. Hum chahte hain keh aap yeh shuru hi se saaf jaan lein.

Khwab bara rakhein, phir us par kaam bhi karein. Sirf chahna shuruaat hai, inaam nahi.
Jo seekhein woh aage batayein — jo ghalat hua, woh bhi. Saath wale ko saath le kar chalein.
Mehnat aur maharat ki qadar hoti hai. Aap kahan se aaye, yeh tay nahi karta keh aap kya ban sakte hain.
Yeh mil kar hi banega, akele nahi. Har koi apna hai, aur har koi apna hissa daalta hai.

steps: Account mein paise daalein

Pehle crypto apne wallet mein tayyar rakhein — jo address milta hai woh taqreeban 15 minute tak chalta hai.
Tag Markets portal mein Deposit dabayein, raqam aur crypto chunein. $10 se thoda zyada bhejein, maslan kam fee wale network par $12 — raaste mein fee katti hai, aur kam az kam $10 pohanchne chahiyein.
Address ke saath copy dabayein, use apne wallet (Binance, RedotPay ya koi aur) mein paste karein aur dekh lein keh shuru ke chaar aur aakhir ke chaar huroof milte hain.
Waqt khatam ho gaya? Naya address lein — purana kabhi istemal na karein.
Crypto sirf usi address par bhejein jo Tag Markets portal aap ko dikhata hai — kabhi kisi shakhs ko nahin, apne sponsor ya kisi leader ko bhi nahin.

steps.note:
Apne wallet mein wohi network chunein jo payment page dikhata hai.
Sab se saste: Solana aur Polygon (ek cent se kam), phir BNB (BEP20, 10–30 cents) aur TRON (TRC20, taqreeban $1–1.5). Ethereum (ERC20) sab se mehenga hai. Bitcoin aur Polkadot bhi chalte hain — Arbitrum nahin.
Hum crypto ki sifarish karte hain: yeh 2–3 ghanton mein pohanch jata hai. Card mein 6–8 working days lagte hain aur yeh aksar radd ho jata hai; bank transfer sirf EU mein hai ($500 se). Aap jahan rehte hain, wahan kis cheez ki ijazat hai, yeh khud dekh lein.

Yahi step copying shuru karta hai — is ke baghair koi trade nahi hoti.
Neeche waale button se Tag Markets mein login karein aur menu mein CopyX chunein (copyxapp.com nahin). SONIC dhoondein aur Details dabayein. Card par shartein hain: 30 % performance fee, kam az kam ek mahina, na koi management fee, na joining fee.
Connect dabayein, apni raqam likhein (kam az kam $10) aur Amplify chunein.
Community Token mein #Aitech likhein, Verify dabayein, Hash mein 000000 likhein aur Submit dabayein.
Dono boxes par tick karein aur Copy Now dabayein.

gold: Gold: pips nahi, dollar mein sochein. Apne broker ka contract size dekhein.

Lambe asbaq, ek waqt mein ek imandar mauzu. Yahan sab kuch seekhne ke liye hai — kuch bhi mashwara nahi.
Qeemat ki ek harkat asal mein kitne ki parti hai

EUR/USD par pip chautha ashariya hai: 1.0850 → 1.0851. 1.00 lot par ek pip taqreeban $10 hai; 0.01 lot par taqreeban $0.10. Gold alag tarah chalta hai: 1.00 lot par gold ki qeemat mein $1 ki harkat taqreeban $100 hai — is liye gold aur oil ke liye pips mein nahi, dollar mein sochein.
Do linein, aur wohi size tay karti hain — aap ka mood nahi. Hamesha sab se chhote lot-step tak neeche round karein, aam taur par 0.01.

Risk in $ = account × risk % / 100
Lots = risk in $ / (stop distance in pips × pip value per lot)

Account $100, risk 2 % = $2. EUR/USD par stop 20 pips door. Yeh banta hai 0.01 lots — sab se chhota size jo hai. Isi liye chhote account mein chaure stop ya bare size ki gunjaish nahi: size himmat nahi, hisaab tay karta hai.

Agar formula 0.01 se kam de — maslan account $50 aur 40 pips stop → 0.0025 lots — to sab se chhota size bhi aap ki chuni hui risk se zyada risk leta hai. Imandar raste: kisi wajah ke sath qareeb-tar stop, ya woh trade chhor dena. Zabardasti 0.01 lagane se aap ka risk-% ek setting nahi, ek khwahish ban jata hai.
Kuch platform points mein ginte hain: 10 points = 1 pip. «100 points» ki harkat 10 pips hai. Dono mila dene se har hisaab das guna ghalat ho jata hai — dekh lein aap ka platform kaun sa dikhata hai.
Contract size har broker par alag ho sakta hai, khaas taur par oil aur index par. MT5 mein: symbol par right-click → Specification. Do minute, jo aap ka har hisaab bachate hain.
Leverage kya badalti hai — aur kya nahi

Leverage yeh tay karti hai keh trade kholne ke liye broker aap ke paise mein se kitna margin ke taur par alag rakhta hai — yeh nahi keh ek pip ki qeemat kitni hai. EUR/USD ka 0.01 lot taqreeban $1,085 ki currency hai: 1:500 par is ke liye taqreeban $2.17 margin chahiye, 1:30 par taqreeban $36. Fi pip nafa ya nuqsan dono sooraton mein wohi $0.10 hai. Zyada leverage jo badalti hai woh yeh hai keh kitne chhote balance se bara size khul sakta hai — aur nuqsanon ka silsila kitni jaldi stop-out level tak pahunchta hai, jahan broker aap ki trades khud band kar deta hai. Leverage ki haddein har mulk mein alag hoti hain — dekh lein keh jahan aap rehte hain wahan kya laagu hota hai.

Margin = lots × contract size × price / leverage
0.01 × 100,000 × 1.0850 / 500 = $2.17

q: Account $100, risk 2 %, EUR/USD par stop 20 pips. Kaun sa size theek hai?
why: $2 ÷ (20 pips × $10 fi lot) = 0.01 lot. 0.10 lot par wohi stop $20 ka parta — account ka paanchwan hissa.

Woh hissa jo koi parhna nahi chahta
Haarna aur wapas aana barabar nahi

10 % haarein to wapsi ke liye 11 % chahiye. 50 % haarein to 100 %. Is liye pehla kaam kabhi «zyada jeeto» nahi — «chhota haaro» hai. Chhoti risk ke bare mein is community ka har usool isi ek hisaab se nikla hai.

Jin post mein ek bot, ek balance aur ek khwab dikhta hai, un ka ek pattern hai: behtareen mahina, magar test ki koi muddat nahi, sab se bara nuqsan nahi, aur aise data par koi nateeja nahi jo system ne kabhi na dekha ho. Ek sawal aksar ki hawa nikaal deta hai: «test kahan hai?» Bohat share kiye gaye ek «AI bot» ko bilkul waise hi bana kar teen saal ke asli data par chalaya gaya — woh 82 % haar gaya.

Screenshot ek lamha dikhata hai. Test mein ek muddat, sab se bara drawdown, aur us data par nataij hote hain jo system ne kabhi nahi dekha. 20 se kam trade koi record nahi, sirf ek rujhan hai. Yeh sawal badtameezi nahi — jis ke paas kuch asli hai, woh khushi se jawab deta hai.

Bari tay-shuda news (rate ke faisle, naukriyon ke adaad) ke aas paas qeemat uchhal sakti hai aur spread chaura ho sakta hai. Ek pursukoon aadat: calendar se hafte ke «High» events jaan lein, aur pehle aur baad ke 15 minute ko toofani samjhein. Yeh koi usool nahi jo hum nafiz karte hain — yeh aadat naye logon ko badtareen qeematon se bachati hai.

Copy trading aur AI tool dekh sakte hain, parh sakte hain, tajweez de sakte hain — magar account, risk aur faisla aap hi ke rehte hain. Tool ko zyada samajhne ke liye istemal karein, nazar pherne ke liye kabhi nahi. Agar aap nahi bata sakte ke koi position kyun khuli hai, to yeh seekhne ka ishara hai — paise dalne ka nahi.

Nuqsan ke baad sab se tez khwahish use fauran wapas jeetne ki hoti hai — usi din, bare size se. Is khwahish ne kisi bhi buri strategy se zyada account khali kiye hain. Jo aadat kaam karti hai: nuqsan likh lein, platform band karein, aur kal usi chhoti risk ke sath wapas aayein.

q: Aap ka 50 % nuqsan hua. Shuru ki jagah par wapas aane ke liye kitna kamana hoga?
why: $100 ka aadha $50 hai, aur $50 ko dobara $100 banne ke liye dugna hona parta hai. Khona aur wapas paana barabar nahi hote.

Sessions, overlap aur din ki tabdeeli
Ek market jo taqreeban kabhi nahi soti

Currencies ki trading itwaar ki shaam se jume ki shaam tak, New York ke waqt ke mutabiq, chaubees ghante chalti hai. Har roz taqreeban 9.6 trillion dollar ka lain dain hota hai (BIS, April 2025), aur us ka teen chauthai hissa Bartania, Amreeka, Singapore aur Hong Kong ki trading desks se guzarta hai. Isi liye un jagahon ke kaam ke auqaat aap ke liye aham hain.

Sydney, Tokyo, London aur New York — har ek ka apna kaam ka din hai. Jab in mein se sirf ek khula ho to market aam taur par pursukoon rehti hai, aur jab do ek saath khule hon to zyada masroof. Tools mein di gayi ghari chaaron ko aap ke apne waqt mein dikhati hai, aur jab Europe aur Amreeka sardiyon ke waqt par jaate hain to woh khud badal jaati hai.

Jab London aur New York dono khule hote hain to ek hi waqt mein zyada log trade karte hain, aur un ghanton mein qeematen aksar zyada chalti hain. Is liye yeh ghante dekhne aur seekhne ke liye achhe hain — aur is ka matlab yeh bhi hai keh stop jaldi lag sakta hai.

New York ke 17:00 baje naya trading din shuru hota hai. Jo position aap us lamhe ke baad bhi khuli rakhte hain, us par swap lagta hai ya milta hai. Bohat se brokers budh ko teen din ka swap lete hain taakeh hafte ke aakhir ka hissa bhi poora ho. Kisi trade ko raat bhar khula rakhne se pehle MT5 mein apne instrument ka swap dekh lein.
Khabar ghari se aage nikal sakti hai

Pehle se tay shuda koi khabar, jaise sharah-e-sood ka faisla, ek pursukoon ghante ko bhi masroof ghante se zyada hila sakti hai. News calendar mein hafte ke High events dekhein, aur yaad rakhein keh us mein waqt New York ka hai.

Masroof ghante «trade karne ke achhe ghante» nahi hain. Yeh woh ghante hain jab zyada halchal hoti hai, dono taraf. Inhein jaanne se aap jo dekhte hain use samajh paate hain — yeh aap ko nahi batata keh kya karna hai.

q: London aur New York dono khule hain. Is ka aam taur par kya matlab hota hai?
a: Zyada trading, aksar dono taraf bari harkatein
Market pursukoon hai aur kam chalti hai
why: Ek saath zyada trading se aksar bari harkatein hoti hain, dono taraf. Stop bhi jaldi lag sakta hai.

Chaar awamil, aur ek harkat ke peeche kayi wajhein kyun hoti hain

Is hub mein bayan ki gayi strategy gold (XAU/USD) mein trade karti hai, kisi currency pair mein nahi. Gold, EUR/USD se mukhtalif tarah bartao karta hai — is mein keh use kya chalata hai, us ki harkat kitni bari hoti hai, aur position rakhne mein kitna kharch aata hai.

World Gold Council un cheezon ko jo gold ko chalati hain chaar girohon mein baant'ti hai: maashi taraqqi, risk aur ghair yaqeeni, opportunity cost (jaise sharah-e-sood aur dollar), aur momentum (paise ka andar ya bahar jaana, aur traders ki positions). Aam taur par in mein se kayi ek saath asar daalte hain.

September 2026 mein gold 8.5 % gir kar 4,176 dollar par aa gaya. Usi mahine Amreeka ki 10 saala sharah-e-sood 0.53 feesad point barhi aur dollar index mein 2 % izafa hua — phir bhi taqreeban 10 arab dollar gold funds mein aaye (World Gold Council, 7 October 2026). Ek akeli khabar shaaz-o-naadir hi kisi harkat ko poori tarah samjha paati hai.
Pips mein nahi, dollar mein sochein

Gold mein qeemat ki 1 dollar ki harkat 1.00 lot par taqreeban 100 dollar aur 0.01 lot par taqreeban 1 dollar hoti hai. Platforms aur websites gold par «pips» aur «points» alag alag tareeqe se ginti hain, is liye ek hi harkat bohat mukhtalif numberon mein nazar aa sakti hai. Aap ke account tak jo pohanchta hai, woh dollar ki raqam hai.

Gold ka apna swap hota hai, jo currency pairs se alag hai. Gold ki trade raat bhar khuli rakhne se pehle MT5 mein XAU/USD ka swap dekhein, aur yeh bhi dekhein keh aap ka broker kis din teen din ka swap leta hai.
Awamil ko jaanne se aap koi harkat hone ke baad use samajh paate hain. Yeh nahi batata keh gold aage kahan jaayega — is ka waada koi nahi kar sakta.

q: Gold ki qeemat 1 dollar chalti hai. 0.01 lot ke liye yeh taqreeban kitna hai?
why: 0.01 lot par taqreeban $1 aur 1.00 lot par taqreeban $100. Gold mein pips mein nahi, dollar mein sochein.

Chart par har candle waqt ka ek tukra hai — ek minute, ek ghanta ya ek din, is par munhasir keh aap kaun sa timeframe chunte hain. Yeh us tukre ki chaar qeematen dikhati hai: kahan khuli, sab se oonchi, sab se neechi, aur kahan band hui.

Mota hissa, body, khulne se band hone tak jaata hai. Upar aur neeche ki patli lakeerein, wicks, sab se oonchi aur sab se neechi qeemat tak pohanchti hain. Lambi wick ka matlab hai keh qeemat itni door gayi aur usi waqt ke tukre mein wapas aa gayi.

Agar band hone ki qeemat khulne se upar ho to candle aam taur par sabz ya safed hoti hai; neeche ho to aam taur par surkh ya kaali. Platforms par rang badle ja sakte hain, is liye sirf rang par bharosa karne ke bajaye khulne aur band hone ki qeemat parhein.
Wohi ghanta daily chart par pursukoon aur one-minute chart par be-qaabu nazar aa sakta hai. Jab do log «chart» ki baat karein to pehle poochein keh woh kaun sa timeframe keh rahe hain.

MT5 mein koi bhi symbol kholein, chart ki qisam candles chunein, aur kisi ek candle ki open, high, low aur close dekhein — computer par us par pointer le ja kar, phone par crosshair se. M1, H1 aur D1 ke darmiyan badlein aur dekhein keh wohi harkatein kitni mukhtalif nazar aati hain.

Candle wohi dikhati hai jo ho chuka hai. Online har jagah candle «patterns» ke naam milte hain, lekin koi akeli candle yeh nahi batati keh aage kya hoga — aise har daawe ko parakhne ki cheez samjhein, maanne ki nahi.

q: Candle ke upar lambi wick dikhati hai keh…
a: Qeemat itni upar gayi aur wapas aayi
why: Candle dikhati hai keh us ke waqt ke tukre mein kya hua — yeh nahi keh aage kya hoga.

Do trades ek bhi ho sakti hain
Phailane se hamesha risk kyun nahi phailta

EUR/USD aur GBP/USD do alag pairs hain, lekin dono mein Amreeki dollar ek hi taraf hai. October 2025 se October 2026 tak 251 mein se 210 trading dinon mein yeh ek hi simt mein chale — taqreeban 84 % (Amreeki markazi bank ka data, FRED ke zariye).
Aap ke risk ke liye is ka matlab

Agar aap dono khareedte hain to aap ne risk nahi phailaya — aap ne taqreeban ek hi daao do baar lagaya hai, dollar ke girne par. Do trades jin mein se har ek mein 2 % risk hai, aise bartao kar sakti hain jaise ek trade jis mein taqreeban 4 % risk ho.
Ulti simt mein chalne wale pairs

Jab kisi pair mein dollar doosri taraf hota hai, jaise USD/JPY mein, to woh pair aksar EUR/USD se ulti simt mein chalta hai. Is liye EUR/USD khareedna aur USD/JPY bechna bhi kaafi had tak ek hi daao do baar hai.
Yeh rujhanaat hain, usool nahi. Yeh maheenon mein badalte hain aur kisi ek khabar wale din toot bhi sakte hain. Pichle saal ka koi adad pichle saal ke baare mein batata hai.
Doosri trade kholne se pehle khud se poochein keh har trade mein aap asal mein kis currency par daao laga rahe hain. Agar dono mein wohi currency hai to risk ko aise jorein jaise yeh ek hi trade ho.
Correlation batata hai keh pairs ek saath kaise chale hain. Yeh nahi batata keh in mein se koi aage kis taraf jaayega.

q: Aap EUR/USD aur GBP/USD khareedte hain aur har ek par 2 % risk lete hain. Taqreeban kitna daao par hai?
a: Taqreeban 2 %, kyunkeh risk bat jaata hai
Taqreeban 4 %, kyunkeh yeh aksar saath chalte hain
Kuch nahi, kyunkeh yeh ek doosre ko kaat dete hain
why: Pichle saal 251 mein se 210 din yeh ek hi simt mein chale. Aksar yeh ek hi daao do baar lagana hota hai.

Swap: raat bhar rakhne ki qeemat
Buy aur sell ki qeemat alag kyun ho sakti hai

Jo position aap New York ke 17:00 baje ke baad bhi khuli rakhte hain, us raat ke liye us par swap lagta hai ya milta hai. Yeh sood ka kharch hai: kisi pair ko raat bhar rakhne ka matlab hai ek currency udhaar lena aur doosri rakhna, aur broker upar se apna hissa bhi jorta hai.
Buy aur sell alag hote hain

Ek hi instrument ko khareedne aur bechne ka swap aam taur par ek jaisa nahi hota — ek minus mein ho sakta hai aur doosra plus mein. Broker ke apne help centre ne XAU/USD ke liye buy par har raat −42.14 points aur sell par +21.92 bataya, aur likha hai «All the Swaps are shown in Points» (mazmoon ki tareekh 27 July 2024 — aaj ke adaad mukhtalif ho sakte hain).
Hafte ke aakhir ko poora karne ke liye hafte ke kisi ek din swap teen baar liya jaata hai. Bohat se brokers budh rakhte hain; dekhein keh aap ka broker kaun sa din rakhta hai.

MT5 mein instrument ki Specification kholein, wahan «Swap long» aur «Swap short» nazar aayenge. Pehli raat ke baad aap ki khuli trade ke Swap column mein nazar aata hai keh aap ne asal mein kitna diya ya paaya, aap ke account ki apni currency mein.
Chhote number jur kar bare bante hain

Ek raat ka jo swap chhota nazar aata hai, woh hafton mein bara ho sakta hai, aur chhote account mein balance ka achha khaasa hissa kha sakta hai. Kisi trade ko kayi din rakhne se pehle ek raat ke swap ko raaton ki ginti se zarb dein.
Plus swap muft ka paisa nahi hai. Qeemat ki ek aam harkat kayi raaton ke swap se kahin bari ho sakti hai — swap sirf intezar ki laagat ya kamaai batata hai.

q: MT5 mein kisi instrument ko khareedne aur bechne ka swap kahan nazar aata hai?
a: Specification mein: Swap long aur Swap short
why: Specification mein dono nazar aate hain. Pehli raat ke baad aap ki khuli trade ka Swap column dikhata hai keh aap ne asal mein kitna diya ya paaya.

Oopar, neeche aur sideways — aur ek hi tareeqa teenon mein kyun nahin chalta
Price teen kaam kar sakti hai

Kisi arse mein price oopar ja sakti hai, neeche ja sakti hai, ya kahin pahunche baghair aage peechhe hoti reh sakti hai. Ek hi tareeqa in mein se ek mein paisa kama sakta hai aur doosre mein ganwa sakta hai.
Oopar ka trend aur neeche ka trend

Oopar ke trend mein har naya high pichhle se ooncha hota hai, aur har low bhi. Neeche ke trend mein highs aur lows har baar neeche hote jaate hain. Muwazne ke liye: World Gold Council ke mutabiq September 2026 mein gold 8.5 % gira. Sirf giraawat neeche ka trend nahin — asal jaanch yeh hai ke highs aur lows neeche hue ya nahin.

Jab price ek chhat aur ek farsh ke darmiyan chalti rahe aur baahar na nikle, to ise sideways ya range kehte hain. Yeh pursukoon lagta hai, lekin trend ke peechhe chalne waale tareeqe yahan aksar achha nahin karte.

Grid ka matlab hai kisi price ke oopar aur neeche muqarrara faasle par orders lagana. Trend pakadne ke liye banaya gaya grid tab sab se achha chalta hai jab price ek hi simt mein bhaage, aur jab price aage peechhe hoti rahe to achha nahin chalta. Sideways market ke liye banaya gaya grid is ka ulat hai: price ke jhoolte rehne tak nafa deta hai, lekin agar price ek hi simt mein chalti rahe to nuqsaan waali position badhti hi jaati hai.
Jaal: giraawat mein aur khareedte jaana

Jo tareeqe har giraawat par aur khareedte hain, woh khareed ki ausat price neeche laate hain — lekin daao par lagi raqam bhi badha dete hain. Agar giraawat jaari rahe to neeche ka har agla qadam pichhle se zyada mehnga padta hai. Isi liye aise tareeqon ko ek had chahiye jahan woh ruk jaayein.

Nahi. Aap account khol sakte hain, Sonic ko chalne de sakte hain, aur kisi ko bhi jode baghair yeh sab kar sakte hain. Introducing broker ban kar kamana ikhtiyari hai, aur platform par kuch bhi is ka taqaza nahi karta.
Tax ke liye apna statement kaise nikaloon?

Windows computer par MetaTrader 5 ka terminal ise export kar sakta hai: neeche History tab kholein, right-click karein, Export chunein aur ise HTML ke taur par save karein, phir use PDF mein print karein. Har deposit aur har withdrawal ki raseedein bhi sambhal kar rakhein. Usool aap ke mulk par munhasir hain, aur hum tax ke baare mein mashwara nahi de sakte.
Madad kahan milegi?

Pehle yeh safha. Phir account se judi har baat ke liye aap ka sponsor — jis ne aap ko bulaya. Agar paisa na pahunche ya kuch ghalat lage to aap ka sponsor baat aage pahunchata hai. Aur Aimpire group mein poochein: aksar kisi aur ka bhi yahi sawal raha hota hai.
Market sab se zyada kab hilti hai?

Tay shuda news ke aas paas. Economic calendar har release par mutawaqqa asar dikhata hai, aur sab se mazboot — jaise interest rate ke faisle — High ke nishan ke saath aate hain. High release ke aas paas ke minuton mein qeematen dono taraf tezi se hil sakti hain, aur spread aksar chaura ho jata hai. Bohat se log High release se pehle aur baad ke taqreeban 15 minute ruk kar hi kuch jaanchte hain. Khayal rahe: calendar feed mein New York ka waqt hota hai, is liye ise apni ghari se milayein. Nuqsan wale din aate hain: rozana ki 427 readings mein se 49. Sab se bura, 3 June 2025 ko −0.64 %, 24× par ek din mein aap ke deposit ka taqreeban −15 % hai; sab se gehri kami, −0.86 %, taqreeban −21 %.
Ausat nuqsan ($134.97) ausat nafe ($93.37) se bada hai. Nateeja jeet ki oonchi sharah ki wajah se achha hai, is liye lagataar nuqsanaat mein jitna jaata hai, lagataar jeet mein utna wapas nahi aata.
Account 5 % par band hota hai. Record ki sab se gehri kami, 0.86 %, us faasle ka taqreeban chhata hissa hai.

Yahan kami har din ke closing balance par naapi gayi hai; din ke andar woh aur gehri ho sakti hai. Record mein gaps hain — sab se lamba 20 August se 12 September 2025 tak hai — aur har gap ko ek hi reading gina jaata hai.

CopyX ke andar strategy card par 0.26 % ke saath «Max DD» ka label laga hai. AiTech ke presentation ki ek slide 0.26 % ko ausat drawdown (kami) aur 0.86 % ko sab se gehri kehti hai. Myfxbook par sab se gehri kami 0.86 % hai, aur hum wohi istemal karte hain.

title: Binance P2P ke zariye USDT khareedne ka marhala waar tareeqa
steps: Binance kholein aur P2P muntakhib karein
Sab se pehle Binance app kholein aur is mein P2P ka option muntakhib karein.
Hamesha aise merchant ka intikhab karein jo verified ho aur jis ki saakh achi ho.
Express ka option muntakhib karein
P2P mein ja kar Express ka option muntakhib karein.
Woh raqam darj karein jis ke ewaz aap USDT khareedna chahte hain.
Apni pasand ka payment tareeqa muntakhib karein. Misaal ke taur par, agar merchant support karta ho to aap Easypaisa ya JazzCash istemal kar sakte hain.
Binance aap ko aap ki raqam aur payment ke tareeqe ke mutabiq dastiyab merchants dikhayega.
Merchant ke reviews check karein
Merchant muntakhib karne se pehle is ke reviews aur ratings achi tarah check karein.
Is baat ko yaqeeni banayein keh merchant verified ho aur is ki transaction history achi ho.
Is ki mukammal shuda transactions ki tadaad aur order completion rate bhi check karein.
Merchant se rabta karein
Apni pasand ke verified merchant ko muntakhib karein.
Is ke chat option mein ja kar message karein aur poochein keh aaya woh is waqt dastiyab hai ya nahi.
Transaction aage barhane se pehle merchant ke jawab ka intezar karein.
Payment transfer karein
Merchant ki janib se dastiyabi ki tasdeeq ke baad, order mein di gayi account tafseelat ke mutabiq payment transfer karein.
Is baat ko yaqeeni banayein keh wusool kunindah ke account ka naam wohi ho jo Binance P2P order mein darj hai.
Sirf wohi payment tareeqa istemal karein jis par order mein ittefaq kiya gaya ho.
Agar aap P2P par naye hain to chhoti raqam se transaction shuru karein aur Binance ki muqarrar karda hudood aur qawaid par amal karein.
USDT ki transaction ki tasdeeq karein
Payment karne ke baad, order mein Paid ka option sirf usi waqt muntakhib karein jab aap waqai payment transfer kar chuke hon.
Merchant ki janib se USDT release karne ka intezar karein.
Jab USDT aap ke Binance account mein aa jaaye to check karein keh poori aur durust raqam mausool hui hai.
Aham hifazati ehtiyatein
Hamesha aise verified merchant ka intikhab karein jis ke reviews ache hon aur transaction history mazboot ho.
Agar account ka naam order mein di gayi tafseelat se mukhtalif ho to payment transfer na karein.
Agar aap USDT farokht kar rahe hain to apne account mein payment mausool hone ki khud tasdeeq kiye baghair kabhi bhi USDT release na karein.
Tamam guftagu aur transaction ki tafseelat Binance ke official P2P chat aur order system mein mehfooz rakhein.
Sirf verified badge dekh kar merchant par mukammal bharosa na karein; is ki transaction history bhi check karein aur Binance ki security guidelines par amal karein.
